title: Monsoon Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired stew made with tender chicken thighs and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the chicken thighs on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add a bit more oil if needed, then add the monsoon spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the saucy and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the stew and water to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
